swimming_pool.evidence: Round blue above-ground pool next to the yellow dot, just east of the house and inside the yellow outline.

detached_structure.evidence: A small brownish roof fragment appears near the upper edge of the outline by the boundary, but it is unclear whether it is inside the lot or a separate structure.

signals.notes: The house has a gray, fairly uniform roof, a paved area to the west, and a round above-ground pool on the east side, with dense mature trees covering much of the eastern and southern yard.
